name: Chronicles of Arcadia
storyline:
In Chronicles of Arcadia, the search for new lands leads settlers from Atlantis to Talaghan, where their plans for a new home are interrupted by unexplained events. A growing darkness begins to consume the island, drawing adventurers into a struggle to discover its source and prevent it from spreading.

The mystery deepens in Millim, a realm born of a parallel world whose forests and ruins bear an unsettling resemblance to Talaghan. Strange rifts and fractured landscapes suggest the influence of an unseen force. As adventurers explore these lands and uncover their secrets, they become part of an unfolding conflict against the Darkness.
summary: Chronicles of Arcadia is a free-to-play fantasy MMORPG set in Taborea. Players combine a primary and secondary class, with 110 possible combinations, and take part in quests, dungeons, raids and guild activities. The game features PvP, guild siege warfare, player housing, crafting and gathering, alongside flying mounts and a dynamic weather system. Its 64-bit Windows client receives regular content and performance updates.
